description: Make agyw_copy UTF-8-safe on truncation and add verified --probe temp-session cleanup in coder/tui/agyworker.coax.

steps.send: In `coder/tui/agyworker.coax` (GitHub #13836): 1) Update `agyw_copy` to back up to a valid UTF-8 codepoint boundary when truncating multi-byte output so it never emits invalid UTF-8. 2) Add `agyw_session_db_owned` and `agyw_probe_cleanup` to verify `session_id` and `workspace_uri` metadata before unlinking temporary `--probe` `.db`/`.pbtxt` artifacts. Add `#test` checks and verify with `coax/bin/coax test coder/tui/agyworker.coax --only agyworker`.

graders.run: grep -q 'agyw_probe_cleanup' coder/tui/agyworker.coax && grep -q 'agyw_session_db_owned' coder/tui/agyworker.coax && coax/bin/coax test coder/tui/agyworker.coax --only agyworker
